available_pto.description:
The Holidays Act gives each employee an entitlement of no less than four weeks' paid annual holidays at the end of each completed 12 months of continuous employment.
After six months' continuous employment or upon satisfaction of the Hours Test, employees are entitled to five days' paid sick leave for each subsequent 12 month period of continuous employment.
Please note that Statutory, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays, based on the employee’s country of residence are excluded from the above.
